questions.question: The value of 2 × 3 ÷ 2 of 3 × 2 ÷ (4 + 4 × 4 ÷ 4 of 4 – 4 ÷ 4 × 4) is:
questions.solution:
Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below:

Step-1: Parts of an equation enclosed in 'Brackets' must be solved first, and in the bracket,

Step-2: Any mathematical 'Of' or 'Exponent' must be solved next,

Step-3: Next, the parts of the equation that contain 'Division' and 'Multiplication' are calculated,

Step-4: Last but not least, the parts of the equation that contain 'Addition' and 'Subtraction' should be calculated.

⇒ 2 × 3 ÷ 2 of 3 × 2 ÷ (4 + 4 × 4 ÷ 4 of 4 – 4 ÷ 4 × 4)

⇒ 2 × 3 ÷ 6 × 2 ÷ (4 + 4 × 4 ÷ 16 – 4 ÷ 4 × 4)

⇒ 2 × 1/2 × 2 ÷ (4 + 4 × 1/4 – 1 × 4)

⇒ 1 × 2 ÷ (4 + 1 – 1 × 4)

⇒ 1 × 2 ÷ (5 – 4)

⇒ 1 × 2 ÷ 1 = 2

questions.question: The average of twelve numbers is 42. The average of the last five numbers is 40, and that of the first four numbers is 44. The 6th number is 6 less than the fifth and 5 less than the 7th number. The average of the 5th and the 7th numbers is:
questions.solution:
Average of 12 numbers = 42

⇒ Sum of all 12 numbers = 12 × 42 = 504

Average of the first 4 numbers = 44

⇒ Sum of the first 4 numbers = 4 × 44 = 176

Average of last five numbers = 40

⇒ Sum of the last five numbers = 5 × 40 = 200

Let the 6th number be x.

∴ 5th number will be = x + 6

∴ 7th number will be = x + 5

Sum of 5th, 6th and 7th number = 504 – 176 – 200 = 128 cm

According to the question

⇒ x + x + 5 + x + 6 = 128

⇒ x = 39

⇒ 7th number = x + 5 = 39 + 5 = 44

⇒ 5th number = x + 6 = 39 + 6 = 45

∴ Average of 7th and 5th number = (44 + 45)/2 = 44.5

questions.solution:

⇒ 2cos²θ – 5cosθ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2cos²θ – 4cosθ – cosθ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2cosθ (cosθ – 2) – 1(cosθ – 2) = 0

⇒ (2cosθ – 1)(cosθ – 2) = 0

⇒ cosθ = 1/2

∴ θ = 60°

⇒ sin θ + tan θ

⇒ sin60° + tan60°

⇒ [√3/2] + √3

questions.question: If a nine-digit number 985x3678y is divisible by 72, then the value of (4x – 3y) is:
questions.solution:
9 digit number 985x3678y is divided by 72,

∴ We can say the number is also divisible by 8 and 9 both.

A number will be divisible by 8 if the last 3 digit of a number is divisible by 8.

⇒ 78y will be divisible by 8 if y = 4

A number will be divisible by 9 if the sum of the digits is divisible by 9.

⇒ 985x36784 will be divisible by 9 if x = 4

⇒ 4x – 3y = 4 × 4 – 3 × 4 = 4

questions.question: If sin {{theta }} = frac{{{{{P}}²} - 1}}{{{{{P}}²} + 1}}, then cos θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
⇒ sinθ = (Perpendicular)/(Hypotenuse) = (P² – 1)/(P² + 1)

By using Pythagoras theorem

⇒ (Hypotenuse)² = (Perpendicular)² + (Base)²

⇒ (P² + 1)² = (P² – 1)² + (Base)²

⇒ P⁴ + 1 + 2P² = P⁴ + 1 – 2P² + (Base)²

⇒ (Base)² = 4P²

⇒ Base = 2P

⇒ cosθ = (Base)/(Hypotenuse) = 2P/(P² + 1)

questions.question: If decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x%, then x% of 210 is how much percent less than (x + 20)% of 180?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Decreasing 120 by x% gives the same result as increasing 40 by x%

**Calculation:**

According to the question

120 × [(100 – x)/100] = 40 × [(100 + x)/100]

⇒ (100 – x)/(100 + x) = 40/120 = 1/3

⇒ x = 50

Now, x% of 210 = 210 × 50/100 = 105

⇒ (x + 20)% of 180 = 180 × 70/100 = 126

**∴ Required percentage = [(126 – 105)/126] × 100 = 16(2)/(3)\%**

questions.question: A solid cube of volume 13824 cm³ is cut into 8 cubes of equal volumes. The ratio of the surface area of the original cube to the sum of the surface areas of three of the smaller cubes is:
questions.solution:
Let the side of the bigger cube be 2 cm (or as you wish answer will be same in given condition)

Volume of the bigger cube = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 cm

Let the side of smaller cube be x.

According to the question

⇒ x × 8 = 8

⇒ x = 1 cm

∴ Side of smaller cube be 1 cm.

As we know

Total surface area of the cube = 6 a²

Total surface area of the bigger cube = 6 × 2² = 6 × 4 = 24 cm²

Total surface area of the smaller cube = 6 × 1² = 6

Sum of the surface area of three of the smaller cubes = 3 × 6 = 18

∴ Required ratio = 24 : 18 = 4 : 3

questions.question: If x + y + z = 19, x² + y² + z² = 133 and xz = y², then the difference between z and x is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 x + y + z = 19

 x² + y² + z² = 133

 xz = y²

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab

**Calculation:**

 x + z = 19 – y

 x² + z² = 133 – y²

Square on both side

x² + z² + 2xz = 361 + y² – 38y 

⇒ 133 – y² + 2y² = 361 + y² – 38y [x² + z² = 133 – y² and xz = y²]

⇒ 38y = 361 – 133 = 228

⇒ y = 6

(x – z)² = x² + z² – 2xz

⇒ (x – z)² = 133 – y² – 2y²

⇒ (x – z)² = 133 – 3y²

⇒ (x – z)² = 133 – 3 × 6²

⇒ (x – z)² = 25

⇒ (x – z) = √25 = 5

**∴ The difference between z and x is 5**

questions.question: A circle is inscribed in a triangle ABC. It touches the sides AB, BC and AC at the points R, P and Q respectively. If AQ = 4.5 cm, PC = 5.5 cm and BR = 6 cm, then the perimeter of the ΔABC is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acb2aeb8a32d68fecff18f014fbaaca4f6cfb6d687ee90555d9bbc39d749ae2a.png] 

As we know,

⇒ AR = AQ, BR = BP and QC = CP

⇒ AQ = 4.5 cm and PC = 5.5 cm and BR = 6 cm

⇒ AQ = AR = 4.5 cm and PC = QC = 5.5 cm

⇒ BR = BP = 6 cm

Perimeter of triangle = AR + BR + BP + PC + CQ + AQ = 4.5 + 6 + 6 + 5.5 + 5.5 + 4.5 = 32 cm

questions.question: A person sold an article at a loss of 15%. Had he sold it for Rs. 30.60 more, he would have gained 9%. To gain 10%, he should have sold it for:
questions.solution:
Let the cost of the article be x.

If he sold the article at a loss of 15% then SP of the article = x × [85/100] = 85x/100

If he sold the article at a gained of 9%, the SP of the article = x × [109/100] = 109x/100

According to the question

[109x/100] – [(85x)/100] = 30.60

⇒ x = 127.5

CP of the article = Rs. 127.5

SP of the article if he sold at 10% profit = 127.5 × [110/100] = Rs. 140.25

questions.question: The ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 2 : 5 : 3. Working together, they can complete a work in 27 days. B and C together can complete 4/9th part of that work in:
questions.solution:
The ratio of the efficiency of A, B and C = 2 : 5 : 3

Total work = (2 + 5 + 3) × 27 = 270

⇒ 4/9th part of the total work = 270 × [4/9] = 120

∴ Required time = 120/(5 + 3) = 120/8 = 15 days

The ratio of the ages of A and B, four years ago, was 4 : 5. Eight years from now, the ratio of the ages of A and B will be 11 : 13. What is the sum of their present ages?
questions.solution:
Let the ratio of ages four years ago of A and B = 4x : 5x

According to the question

⇒ (4x + 12) / (5x + 12) = 11/13

⇒ x = 8

Age of A four years ago = 4x = 4 × 8 = 32 years

⇒ Present age of A = 32 + 4 = 36

Age of B four years ago = 5x = 5 × 8 = 40 years

⇒ Present age of B = 40 + 4 = 44 years

∴ Sum of their present ages = 36 + 44 = 80 years

In a circle of radius 10 cm, with centre O, PQ and PR are two chords each of length 12 cm. PO bisects chord QR at the points S. The length of OS is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

PQ = PR = 12 cm 

OR = OQ = OP = 10 cm

**Concept used:**

When a line is drawn from the centre of a circle to the mid-point of a chord, then the line is perpendicular to the chord.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d21fafec53417ee5b89521a56d0993b8526301b722fc7727fedad030bdfa526.png] 

Suppose SQ = RS = x cm and OS = y cm

⇒ PS = (10 – y)

Since QR is a chord and S is the midpoint.

⇒ ∠PSQ = ∠PSR = 90°

In ΔPRS

⇒ RP² = PS² + RS² [Using Pythagoras theorem]

⇒12² = (10 – y)² + x²

⇒ 144 = 10² + y² – 2 × 10 × y + x²

⇒ 144 = 100 + y² – 20y + x² ---- (1)

In ΔRSO,

⇒ OR² = RS² + OS² [Using Pythagoras theorem]

⇒ 10² = x² + y²

⇒ 100 = x² + y² ---- (2)

Subtract equation (2) from equation (1)

⇒ 144 – 100 = 100 + y² – 20y + x² – x² – y²

⇒ 44 = 100 – 20y

⇒ y = 2.8

**∴ Length of OS = 2.8**
